snippet.title: To the End of Days - Story Trailer (Dread X Collection II) | Scythe Dev Team
snippet.description:
Trailer for the upcoming Scythe Dev Team title, "TO THE END OF DAYS" is now available!

This FPS puts you in the shoes of a man trying to travel cross-country to make it back to his family before a deadly, planet killer comet strikes. Can you survive the apocalypse? Can you make it back to your family in time? Find out on the Dread X Collection II!

Join us on our discord!
https://discord.gg/scythesaga

Support Scythe Dev Team and Scythe Saga Records!
